name: Exp_Bezier_StDev
summary: This EA trades based on the Bezier_StDev custom indicator, which combines Bezier curve smoothing with standard deviation bands to identify overbought/oversold conditions. It supports three signal modes (point-based, directional, and disabled) for both entry and exit, and uses configurable money management with stop loss and take profit. The strategy opens buy positions on upward turning points and sell positions on downward turning points of the smoothed curve.
summary_zh: 该EA基于Bezier_StDev自定义指标进行交易，该指标结合贝塞尔曲线平滑和标准差通道来识别超买/超卖条件。它支持三种信号模式（点位、方向、禁用）分别控制入场和出场，并使用可配置的资金管理配合止损止盈。策略在平滑曲线的向上拐点开多仓，在向下拐点开空仓。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略是基于贝塞尔曲线平滑叠加标准差通道的均值回归思路。入场条件分为三种模式：POINT模式通过读取指标的信号缓冲区（buffer 3为买入信号，buffer 2为卖出信号）判断；DIRECT模式通过比较相邻三根K线的贝塞尔曲线值判断拐点（V形反转）来开仓；WITHOUT模式则禁用信号。出场条件同样支持三种模式：POINT模式根据信号缓冲区、DIRECT模式根据曲线斜率方向变化判断趋势反转平仓。仓位管理采用五种模式（自由保证金、余额、亏损后自由保证金、亏损后余额、固定手数），通过MM参数控制风险比例。资金管理方面设有止损和止盈参数，默认止损1000点、止盈2000点，风险回报比为1:2。策略默认在H4周期运行，使用SignalBar=1即前一根已收盘K线的信号，避免了未收盘K线信号闪烁的问题。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is based on mean reversion using Bezier curve smoothing overlaid with standard deviation bands. Entry conditions come in three modes: POINT mode reads the indicator's signal buffers (buffer 3 for buy signals, buffer 2 for sell signals); DIRECT mode detects inflection points by comparing three consecutive Bezier curve values (V-shaped reversal patterns) to open positions; WITHOUT mode disables the signal entirely. Exit conditions also support three modes: POINT mode uses signal buffers, while DIRECT mode detects trend reversal by comparing curve slope direction changes to close positions. Position sizing offers five modes (free margin, balance, loss-adjusted free margin, loss-adjusted balance, and fixed lot), controlled by the MM parameter for risk proportion. Money management includes configurable stop loss and take profit, defaulting to 1000 and 2000 points respectively, yielding a 1:2 risk-reward ratio. The strategy operates on the H4 timeframe by default and uses SignalBar=1, meaning signals from the last closed bar, which avoids signal flickering issues from unclosed bars.

pros: 灵活的信号模式设计，入场和出场可独立配置POINT/DIRECT/WITHOUT三种模式，适应不同市场环境
使用SignalBar=1基于已收盘K线计算信号，避免未收盘K线信号闪烁导致的误交易
内置新K线检测机制（CIsNewBar），避免同一根K线内重复开仓
止损止盈参数明确，默认风险回报比1:2较为合理
支持五种仓位管理模式，资金管理灵活度高
pros_en: Flexible signal mode design with independent POINT/DIRECT/WITHOUT configuration for entry and exit, adaptable to different market conditions
Uses SignalBar=1 to calculate signals from closed bars only, avoiding false trades caused by signal flickering on unclosed bars
Built-in new bar detection mechanism (CIsNewBar) prevents duplicate position openings within the same bar
Clear stop loss and take profit parameters with a reasonable default risk-reward ratio of 1:2
Supports five position sizing modes providing high flexibility in money management
cons: 依赖自定义指标Bezier_StDev，指标代码不可见无法验证其算法正确性
DIRECT模式仅用2-3根K线判断拐点，在震荡行情中容易产生频繁假信号
没有点差过滤和交易时间过滤，在高点差时段可能不利
止损1000点、止盈2000点范围较大，对某些品种可能不合适
缺少最大持仓数限制和总风险控制机制
cons_en: Depends on the custom Bezier_StDev indicator whose source code is not visible, making algorithm correctness unverifiable
DIRECT mode uses only 2-3 bars to detect inflection points, prone to frequent false signals in choppy markets
No spread filter or trading session filter, potentially disadvantageous during high-spread periods
Stop loss of 1000 points and take profit of 2000 points are wide ranges that may not suit all instruments
Lacks maximum position count limits and overall portfolio risk control mechanisms
improvements: 增加点差过滤机制，当点差超过阈值时暂停开仓
增加最大同时持仓数限制和回撤保护机制
建议添加交易时段过滤，避开低流动性时段
improvements_en: Add a spread filter mechanism to pause new positions when spread exceeds a threshold
Add maximum concurrent position limits and drawdown protection mechanisms
Consider adding trading session filters to avoid low-liquidity periods

risk_points: 依赖外部自定义指标，指标加载失败将导致EA无法运行
DIRECT模式下拐点判断逻辑简单，可能在震荡市中频繁开平仓造成滑点损失
无最大持仓限制，极端行情下可能累计过多仓位
risk_points_en: Dependency on external custom indicator; failure to load will prevent the EA from running
Simple inflection point logic in DIRECT mode may cause frequent open/close cycles in choppy markets, leading to slippage losses
No maximum position limit, potentially accumulating excessive exposure during extreme market conditions
